notes: Verified against catalog: EE technical core and the four social-sciences/humanities depth sequences (History, Economics, Political Science, Sociology) are corroborated on the page, including specific HISC/HILD/HIUS/ECON/POLI/SOCI course numbers. Lower-division 72 units; upper-division 68 units; 140 units in major. Confidence kept medium because the intricate per-concentration selection rules (e.g., sociology concentration sub-groups, economics Track A vs B splits) are complex and only partially itemized in a quick fetch; exact course-count sub-rules should be reconfirmed against the department's page.

buckets.label: Social Sciences/Humanities prerequisites
buckets.note: 8 units; prerequisites for the chosen upper-division depth (examples listed)

buckets.label: Design course (upper-division)
buckets.note: 4 units; ECE 191, or 190/111/118/155B/155C with departmental approval; may relate to a social-sciences/humanities project

buckets.label: Technical electives (upper-division)
buckets.note: Two upper-division engineering/math/physics courses plus two upper/lower-division engineering/math/physics/chemistry/biology

buckets.label: Depth: History Studies
buckets.note: 24 units, 6 courses; min four in a specific history field, at least one in history of science/technology, at least one colloquium

buckets.label: Depth: Economics Studies Track A (Finance)
buckets.note: 24 units, 6 courses; required ECON 100A-B-C, 173A-B, plus one elective from the remaining listed

buckets.label: Depth: Economics Studies Track B (Data Analysis)
buckets.note: 28 units, 7 courses; required ECON 100A-B-C, 120B-C, plus two electives from the remaining listed

buckets.label: Depth: Political Science Studies
buckets.note: 24 units, 6 courses; min four from the Policy Analysis group (160AA,160AB,162,163,165,168,170A); min two from the Additional group

buckets.label: Depth: Sociology Studies
buckets.note: 32 units, 8 courses; two lower-division from SOCI 1/2/30 plus six upper-division from ONE concentration: Science and Medicine, Law and Society, Economy and Society, International Studies, or General Sociology
